status: New test-scheduler freeze; revision-2 holdout NOT RUN until this record and its tree pins are committed. The original holdout and record remain unchanged historical evidence. Listening gate BLOCKED.
reason: Issue #310: the original test runner enqueued all 16 calibration cases or all 48 holdout cases at once, making one SwiftPM helper exceed the four-core budget. The pure WWRender source, fixture generation, calibration seed, case counts, independent truth, objective gates and renderer recipe are unchanged.
pinnedTreesRule: Both paths are relative to Packages/WaveWranglerKit and are checked against working-tree Git IDs by RenderFreezeTests. The source tree must be byte-identical to the original freeze. A later change to either tree requires a new dated freeze revision and a fresh disjoint holdout.
scheduler: A test-only task group enqueues at most two synthetic cases; each completion admits one next case. It preserves all records, their canonical order, the full 16/48 case counts, and the fixed multi-span case. scripts/test.sh runs only one top-level test at a time.
seedDerivation: First 8 bytes, big-endian, of SHA-256("ww-m2-fixture|v1|M2-RENDER-001|<split>|<index>"). Calibration split remains "calibration" and the original holdout remains "holdout"; this revision uses "holdout-2" for all 48 new cases. RenderFreezeTests verifies 48 unique new seeds disjoint from the 16 calibration and 48 old holdout seeds.

generator.case: One group, one 6-channel occurrence on one affine epoch; stratum = index mod 8.
generator.tones: Channel c: amplitude 0.5 at fraction r_c * (1 - 0.02 u) of lower Nyquist; r=[0.02,0.15,0.3,0.5,0.7,0.8], seeded phase.
generator.stopband: When 0.98 * (Fin/(a Fout)) > 1.01, six tones between output Nyquist and 0.98 input Nyquist (normalised).
generator.landmarks: 0.9-amplitude seeded-sign impulse at N/8 on every channel, and at N/4 + c*N/12 on channel c only.
generator.inactive: Channel index mod 6 carries -1 dBFS seeded uniform noise; all other channels exact zero.
generator.multiSpan: One unchanged fixed MixedGroup case per split (kink, gap, unsupported epoch, 44.1/48 kHz occurrences), with 12 landmarks and two skew pairs. The same multi-span case appears in all splits as disclosed regression coverage; it is not held out.

truth: The generator's WWTimeMap forward (alignedTime) and inverse (sourceFrame), not the render plan. Tone truth uses the exact inverse at hull ends and linear interpolation within an affine segment.
measurement: Unchanged from m2-freeze-render: steady frames with every tap in span; least-squares gain/phase/residual vs exact tone, parabolic landmark peak within four frames of truth with sign, common-impulse and phase-derived skew, inactive peak in dBFS. NaN or missing evidence fails. Canonical records sort by (caseIndex, kind, channel, encoded JSON).

renderer.recipe: m2Candidate: Kaiser-windowed sinc, halfWidth 32 taps per side, passband edge 0.8, stopband edge 1.0, beta 9.6, 2048 table phases, chunk 4096 output frames, maximum decimation 64

holdoutProtocol: On a clean commit containing this complete record and exact pinned trees, run each new holdout case once with the disjoint holdout-2 split; publish every case and gate, runtime/CPU measurements and any failures without substituting revision-1 evidence. Do not rerun or relabel the original holdout.
